question: ¿En cuántos ensayos de melanoma se prueba nivolumab?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.nct_id)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.browse_conditions b WHERE b.nct_id = s.nct_id AND b.downcase_mesh_term = 'melanoma')
  AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.interventions i WHERE i.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (lower(i.name) LIKE '%nivolumab%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%opdivo%' OR lower(i.name) LIKE '%bms-936558%'))
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM aact.intervention_other_names o WHERE o.nct_id = s.nct_id AND (lower(o.name) LIKE '%nivolumab%' OR lower(o.name) LIKE '%opdivo%' OR lower(o.name) LIKE '%bms-936558%')))
